pr_title: roachtest: add port forwarding to rust-postgres test
pr_body:
This patch adds port forwarding to the rust-postgres test since
rust-postgres expects to be able to connect to the database at
port 5433, but the default is 26257. The previous solution of
using a `--port 5433` flag prevented other connections expecting
the default port from working (e.g. test teardown checks).

Fixes #103824

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/104690)

review_comments: i don't follow - why do we install this package after the commands that use it? shouldn't it be before, maybe as part of the existing line where we call `apt-get install`?

The `iptables` utility is included by default, but it doesn't automatically save any changes for future sessions. We would need to write the configuration to a file and then restore from it in a new session. The `iptables-persistent` package handles that saving and restoring for us and installing it after lets us save the current configuration.
